title: Signal Login: optional registration without a phone number will require a one-time payment
excerpt: The payment requirement for registration without a phone number is intended to serve as an additional barrier against spam and abuse. The fees will also help support Signal's mission.
content_html:
As our regular readers know, Signal is working on a way to register an account without a phone number. New hints reveal that this optional alternative registration method for Signal will require a one-time payment.

The ability to register for Signal without a phone number is a frequently requested feature. While Signal hides phone numbers by default and gives users control over who can discover them, some users would still like the option to create an account without using a phone number.

As we wrote in our article last week, the main challenge and one of the reasons Signal does not yet offer registration without a phone number is preventing spam and abuse. In a recently published video, Signal CTO Ehren Kret said that Signal needed to find a way to induce a cost for signing up without a phone number.

At the time, it was unclear whether this “cost” would mean a monetary fee or another type of barrier designed to prevent abuse. Now, we have uncovered more details about the feature.

Signal Login, one-time payment, price unknown

New references in Signal’s source code reveal that this feature will be called “Signal Login”. This appears to be the internal and likely public name for Signal’s upcoming phone number-free registration option.

Signal’s source code also shows that Signal Login will be offered as a paid option. It will require a one-time payment and is not a subscription. The payment requirement is intended to serve as an additional barrier against spam and abuse. Given that Signal is a non-profit organization, the fees are expected to be reasonable and will help support Signal’s mission.

The code currently contains only example amounts; the exact price is not yet known.

Availability

Registration without a phone number will be optional and will not replace the current signup process.

It’s not yet known when Signal Login will be available. Based on the references and hints found in the source code, we expect it to become available in the near future.

As always, as soon as there’s more news, you’ll find it on our website and social media.

content_html_zh:
正如我们的老读者所知，Signal 正在研究一种无需电话号码即可注册帐户的方法。 新的提示表明，这种可选的 Signal 替代注册方法将需要一次性付款。

无需电话号码即可注册 Signal 的功能是一项经常被要求的功能。 虽然 Signal 默认隐藏电话号码并让用户控制谁可以发现它们，但一些用户仍然希望选择不使用电话号码来创建帐户。

正如我们上周在文章中所写，Signal 尚未提供无需电话号码的注册服务的主要挑战和原因之一是防止垃圾邮件和滥用。 在最近发布的视频中，Signal 首席技术官 Ehren Kret 表示，Signal 需要找到一种方法来诱导无需电话号码的注册费用。

当时，尚不清楚这种“成本”是否意味着金钱费用或旨在防止滥用的其他类型的障碍。 现在，我们发现了有关该功能的更多细节。

信号登录，一次性付款，价格未知

Signal 源代码中的新引用显示该功能将被称为“Signal Login”。 这似乎是 Signal 即将推出的免电话号码注册选项的内部名称，也可能是公开名称。

Signal 的源代码还显示 Signal Login 将作为付费选项提供。 它需要一次性付款，而不是订阅。 付款要求旨在作为防止垃圾邮件和滥用的额外障碍。 鉴于 Signal 是一个非营利组织，费用预计是合理的，并将有助于支持 Signal 的使命。

该代码当前仅包含示例金额；确切的价格尚不清楚。

可用性

没有电话号码的注册是可选的，并且不会取代当前的注册流程。

目前尚不清楚 Signal Login 何时可用。 根据源代码中的参考和提示，我们预计它会在不久的将来可用。

一如既往，一旦有更多新闻，您就会在我们的网站和社交媒体上找到它。
